description: TB, 2005 June regular phase: 50 of 50 selections from MLB's draft feed (historical importer).

coverage_claims.gap_notes: MLB's draft feed lists 50 selection(s) for the club in the June regular phase. Independent count: 50 (Baseball-Reference franchise-year page, Internet Archive capture 20240630112206: 50 listed, 50 matched to MLB's picks by name (3 by surname in the same round: #208 MLB "Michael Wlodarczyk" / "Mike Wlodarczyk"; #448 MLB "Matthew Fisher" / "Matt Fisher"; #1371 MLB "William Oliver" / "Will Oliver")). Signing status, bonuses and outcomes not researched.
